t: The Master Prompt & Chip O'Theseus: Engineering Persistent AI Collaboration in Pipulate
s: Pipulate addresses AI's ephemeral nature through 'AI Education' (AIE) and the 'Master Prompt' for onboarding. 'Chip O'Theseus' enables durable AI memory and identity, transforming AI into a persistent collaborator.
sub: Pipulate's architecture for persistent human-AI collaboration using AI Education (AIE).
The 'Master Prompt' as a foundational blueprint for onboarding amnesiac AI models.
'Chip O'Theseus' system for achieving durable AI memory and identity across ephemeral compute instances.
Technical stack simplification (FastAPI, HTMX, Nix Flake) for AI development.
Defining roles for human and AI collaborators in Pipulate's workflow.
